name: noisy
_why: The same conversation with a fan in the room (-38 dBFS room tone, ~16 dB above quiet) and a quieter talker. The energy VAD's threshold is calibrated against a specific noise floor, so this is where it should fall apart and Silero should not. Run it both ways: --vad silero and --vad energy.

turns.say: hello lamp can you hear me
it is quite loud in here today
